central_question: When does security-force assistance create autonomous military capability, and when does it create only externally supported performance?
claim_boundary: All primary tests are synthetic mechanism tests inside Pineland. Historical cases may be used only after the synthetic forms and analysis are frozen, and only as external consistency diagnostics rather than calibration targets.

primary_counterfactual_design.branching_rule: At T, clone the identical world state and future random stream into SUPPORT_ON and SUPPORT_OFF branches.
primary_counterfactual_design.support_on: All designated removable external-support channels continue under their pre-T policy.
primary_counterfactual_design.support_off: All designated removable external-support channels are set to zero at T; all indigenous stocks and state variables remain unchanged.

capability_assay_requirements.rule: C must be behavioral and outcome-facing rather than a direct weighted sum of autonomy predictors.
capability_assay_requirements.warning: Do not define C from training throughput, logistics autonomy, command reliability, or other variables that later appear as autonomy predictors.

primary_hypotheses.name: Performance Masking
primary_hypotheses.prediction: Supported battlefield performance can substantially overstate post-withdrawal autonomous capability under substitution-heavy assistance.
primary_hypotheses.falsifier: Across assistance architectures, supported performance predicts post-withdrawal retention as well as or better than explicitly indigenous state-flow measures.

primary_hypotheses.name: Autonomy Bottleneck
primary_hypotheses.prediction: Post-withdrawal retention is better predicted by subsystem complementarity or binding constraints than by average indigenous capability.
frozen_competitors: arithmetic mean of subsystem autonomy coordinates
geometric mean of subsystem autonomy coordinates
regularized additive model with no interactions
primary_hypotheses.falsifier: Mean/additive capability transports at least as well as bottleneck/complementarity forms on held-out support and burden families.

primary_hypotheses.name: Regeneration
primary_hypotheses.prediction: Long-horizon withdrawal resilience is predicted more strongly by indigenous regeneration flows than by withdrawal-day readiness/personnel/supply stocks.
flow_group: command recovery or continuity if implemented
primary_hypotheses.falsifier: Frozen stock-only models transport as well as stock-flow models at 90- and 180-day horizons.

primary_hypotheses.name: Complexity-Capacity Mismatch
primary_hypotheses.prediction: Increasing force-system complexity can raise supported performance while reducing autonomous retention when indigenous regenerative capacity is insufficient.
primary_hypotheses.falsifier: After cost and threat are controlled, added modeled complexity never creates a negative supported-performance/autonomy tradeoff.

assistance_architecture_tests_after_prim.name: substitution-heavy
assistance_architecture_tests_after_prim.definition: Allocate a larger equal-cost share to removable external combat/logistics/command effects.

assistance_architecture_tests_after_prim.name: capacity-heavy
assistance_architecture_tests_after_prim.definition: Allocate a larger equal-cost share to endogenous training, logistics, command, and replacement-generation capacity.

assistance_architecture_tests_after_prim.name: bottleneck-targeted
assistance_architecture_tests_after_prim.definition: Allocate equal-cost capacity-building assistance toward the currently measured binding indigenous subsystem using only information permitted by the frozen policy rule.

assistance_architecture_tests_after_prim.name: calendar transition
assistance_architecture_tests_after_prim.definition: Withdraw or taper support according to elapsed time.

assistance_architecture_tests_after_prim.name: capability-conditioned transition
assistance_architecture_tests_after_prim.definition: Withdraw or taper according to frozen indigenous-autonomy criteria.

cost_control.rule: Assistance architectures compared as policy designs must have equal discounted donor cost or an explicitly reported cost-effectiveness frontier.
cost_control.prohibition: Do not allow a 'more support for longer' treatment to masquerade as an architecture result.

rules: measure realized partner-owned stocks and flows

candidate_regenerative_coordinates.definition_rule: tau_j must be computed from an audited indigenous stock/service buffer and observed endogenous net flow; external support must be excluded from the regenerative numerator/denominator accounting.
candidate_regenerative_coordinates.dynamic_bottleneck_test: Estimate local marginal response of R_h to each subsystem intervention; after relieving the strongest binding dimension, repeat to test whether the binding subsystem changes.

historical_case_firewall.afghanistan: Motivation and later diagnostic only until all primary synthetic forms, gates, and code are frozen.
prohibited_before_freeze: choosing autonomy thresholds because they fit ANA outcomes
adding contractor maintenance solely to force an Afghanistan-like failure
selecting successful predictors after inspecting historical case fit

required_before_simulation: small smoke test proving support-off removes only designated external channels
